messages.text:
Hi Y'all,
Notes from ABM call today ( watered down ):
• Devices are covered internationally, but they need to be fixed in the US (since it's a US Plan ) . ( 1-2 weeks) A window for a laptop to be fixed. 
Since the plan is based in the US, they can only be fixed there.
• Old devices (5 years or older) cannot be added to the ABM unless they are physically added and configured. Fixes aren't guaranteed.  
• Moving forward, when we have a laptop, it will have two profiles  ( Caliber admin / the person ) 
That way, it covers that way; it's easier to wipe the whole ( since it's better to have Devices than Users )

Hrushi can chime in with more detail( and maybe a stronger explanation), but I just wanted to put all of this in one place.
